title: Bronze Rewards Card: Understanding Your 1% Cash Back Rewards
summary: Explains the Bronze Rewards Card’s 1.0% cash back: rewards are calculated on the posted amount of eligible purchases, reversed for returns/refunds, and not earned for disputed transactions until resolved. It also notes there’s no annual fee ($0.00) and that fees/interest/cash-like transactions are typically ineligible, with rewards shown on monthly statements and online by cycle and total.
faqs: What is the Bronze Rewards Card cash back rate, and is there an annual fee?
How are rewards calculated—on the purchase amount when posted or at some other time?
What happens to rewards if I return or refund a purchase?
Do disputed transactions earn cash back while they’re unresolved?
Which types of charges are typically ineligible for the 1.0% rewards (fees, interest, cash-like transactions)?
Where can I see my rewards totals and “by cycle” rewards—monthly statement or online?
